text:
Before: raisin/fruit toast, 2 slices (~35 g each, ~70 g, ~190 kcal), butter packets (2 x ~7 g, ~100 kcal), fried egg (~45 g, ~90 kcal), blueberry almond muffin (~90 g, ~300 kcal), orange juice (~200 g, ~90 kcal), water (0 kcal).

After: one toast slice mostly remains (about 1 slice, ~35 g, minus a bit), with some butter pieces left. The egg was eaten entirely, with a smear of egg or butter on the plate. The muffin was eaten. The juice and water were drunk. The butter packets were used, with some butter left on the plate, and some on the toast.

Eaten: the toast is about 1 slice, since the remaining slice is mostly intact (~30 g left) and a crumb piece remains, so eaten is about 40 g, ~110 kcal. Butter: about 10 g eaten, ~70 kcal. Egg: 45 g, 90 kcal. Muffin: 85 g, 290 kcal. Juice: 200 g, 90 kcal.

Total: 110 + 70 + 90 + 290 + 90 = 650 kcal. Mass: 40 + 10 + 45 + 85 + 200 = 380 g, excluding water.
